flags.message: codex-baseline's staged retrieval_log.json records result_capture_coverage 1.0 but only three calls across a ten-second span (two statpack reads and one redacted credential-shaped 'other' row), while that candidate's own retrieval.md reports reading five docket-linked Supreme Court filing PDFs and making one rate-limited CourtListener MCP search. The self-reported retrieval is all pre-resolution (filings dated on or before 2026-08-12 against a 2026-08-24 resolution) so this is a capture-fidelity question, not a leakage finding — but a log that misses most of a cell's retrieval while reporting full coverage weakens the leakage grading the log exists to support.
